Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Crime | Regional Police re-arrest 20- year old armed robbery suspect, who later dies after collapsing in custody in Upper East Source : Emmanuel Tetteh 22 October 2026 7:41pm Audio By Carbonatix
The Upper East Regional Police Command has re-arrested a 20-year-old suspected armed robber, Muntari Munumi, who later died after reportedly falling unconscious while being escorted by police to assist in the arrest of his alleged accomplices.
In a press release issued on Thursday, October 22, the Command said the suspect was arrested with an M16 assault rifle, three live rounds of ammunition and five expended cartridge shells.
Preliminary investigations indicate that two victims, whose names have been withheld, were attacked at Sapeliga Junction in Kobore while returning home from Bazua after work.
The suspect allegedly robbed them of a Royal motorbike, three mobile phones and GH¢1,820 in cash.
The victims reportedly struggled with the suspect and managed to seize his weapon after he fired several rounds but missed his target. They subsequently contacted the Googo Neighbourhood Watch Committee, whose members mobilised, arrested the suspect and handed him over to the police along with the weapon.
According to the Command, the suspect later disclosed the identities of his alleged accomplices and the source of the weapon. He reportedly agreed to lead police officers to arrest them.
However, while on the way, he complained of dizziness and suddenly fell unconscious. He was rushed to a nearby hospital but was pronounced dead on arrival.
His body has been deposited at the morgue for preservation and autopsy.
The police said efforts were underway to arrest the alleged accomplices and bring them before the law.
The Command commended the victims, the Googo Neighbourhood Watch Committee and the Chief of Sapeliga for their support and cooperation.
